name: DWELL
summary: A drone you live inside. Tilt walks a lattice of just ratios and the tones you pass stay; one knob from pure sines to a beating wall; a change takes 20 s. Sing a note: it stacks it. The room sings.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: ROOM PASS plays through the speaker and listens with the mic: it needs the speaker on (or the line out into a real speaker) and a room; on headphones it stops after the first pass. The root sits low (65 Hz at OCTAVE 3): the small speaker loses it, the line out has it.
status_note: Built 2026-10-24, checked in the host simulator. Not on a board yet.
